name: integer-precision-native-only
description: Validates that native SDKs preserve integer values outside JavaScript's safe integer range (Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = 2^53-1). Web browsers represent all numbers as IEEE 754 doubles and lose precision on integers larger than 2^53, so this fixture is skipped for the web SDK.

_skip.reason: JavaScript cannot represent integers beyond 2^53-1 without loss of precision. Native SDKs (iOS, Android, etc.) have true 64-bit integer types. This fixture uses values outside safe JS integer range.
